{{Quote|Huzzah for Perpe... Predpre... Who gave him a name like that?|Sebb about [[Prepredenko]]|<ref name="Vader's Quest 3">[[Vader's Quest 3|''Vader's Quest'' 3]]</ref>}}
'''Sebb''' was a local [[Jazbinan]] bar fly on [[Jazbina/Legends|Jazbina]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|'Twas only Prepredenko, after all. Another one, Sebb?''"<br />"''No, thanks. You gonna laugh, but I don't feel like it, somehow.''"<br />"''I ain't gonna laugh. I '''ain't'''.|The bartender and Sebb|<ref name="Vader's Quest 4">[[Vader's Quest 4|''Vader's Quest'' 4]]</ref>}}
After seeing [[3DVO]]'s broadcast of an imprisoned Prepredenko at a local bar, Sebb was offered a drink by the [[Jazbinan bartender|bartender]] but refused, something out character for him. He and many other Jazbinans gathered their weapons and attacked [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on Jazbina. Sebb threw a glass bottle at a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] and when Vader demanded who dared to do such a thing, Sebb defiantly replied, "I dare...Darfader!" He led the mob of locals,which eventually drove [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the Empire off the planet.
